Yes. Jenny Maids offers weekly, bi-weekly, and monthly recurring cleaning packages so you can choose the schedule that works best for your home and lifestyle.

Do recurring cleaning packages come with a discount?

Yes. If you sign up for recurring cleaning service, we offer a percentage discount based on the frequency of your package.

How often should I have my home professionally cleaned?

That depends on your household, lifestyle, and preferences. Many homeowners choose bi-weekly service for steady upkeep, while others prefer weekly or monthly service depending on their needs.

Do you offer one-time cleaning services?

Yes. We offer one-time cleaning services such as deep cleaning, spring cleaning, fall cleaning, party cleaning, and special occasion cleaning.

Can I book cleaning before or after a party or event?

Absolutely. Our party cleaning and all occasions cleaning services are perfect for pre-event preparation and post-event cleanup so you can focus on enjoying your guests.

Do you clean blinds?

Yes. We offer blinds hand wipe cleaning as an add-on or part of a more detailed service to help remove dust and improve the overall look of your home.

Do you offer office cleaning?

Yes. Jenny Maids also provides office cleaning for small businesses and workspaces that want a clean, professional, and welcoming environment.

Do I need to be home during the cleaning?

No, you do not have to be home during your cleaning appointment. Many clients provide access ahead of time, and we take care of the rest.

Do you bring your own cleaning supplies?

Yes. We bring the supplies and tools needed to complete your cleaning service, so you do not have to worry about providing products or equipment.

How do I get a quote for house cleaning?

Getting started is easy. Just contact Jenny Maids through the website or by phone, and we will provide a free quote based on your home, service needs, and preferred schedule.

At Jenny Maids, we believe a clean home should feel more than just tidy—it should feel welcoming, relaxing, and cared for. That belief is what drives everything we do, from the way we clean to the way we treat our customers.
